title: Yue Liang Dai Biao Wo De Xin

lines.translation: You ask me how deeply I love you

lines.text: 我的情也真 我的愛也真
lines.translation: My feelings are true, my love is true
You ask me how deeply I love you

lines.text: 我的情不移 我的愛不變
lines.translation: My feelings won't waver, my love won't change
Has kept me longing until now
You ask me how deeply I love you

lines.text: 你去想一想 你去看一看
lines.translation: Go and think it over, go and take a look
